influences.name: Tommy Mottola
influences.context: I barely spoke English when Tommy [Mottola] gave me that vote of confidence to release music in English with 'Whenever, Wherever.' I felt that 'Objection' was the song I had to come out with, because it was the first song I did in English. So he said no, let's go with 'Whatever, Whatever.' That's when he convinced me what his vision went.
